items.description:

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain at times. Moderate to fresh east or southeast wind falling light and variable at times in the south. Maximum temperature 11°C.


##Temperature##

5-10

##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with a few showery outbreaks of rain on Thursday morning, then tending to become drier in the afternoon although staying largely cloudy. Fresh to strong east or northeast wind, falling moderate at times later. Top temperature 9°C. Comments: Strong winds quickly developing.
